No, bithionol cannot be used in the antibacterial body wash, regardless of the level, because bithionol is deemed to render any cosmetic product containing it injurious to users under 21 CFR 700.11(a). The regulation states that bithionol is a deleterious substance and any cosmetic containing it is considered adulterated [1].

21 CFR 700.11(a) prohibits the use of bithionol in cosmetics due to its potential to cause photosensitivity in humans, with possible persistent severe reactions, and risk of cross-sensitization with other chemicals like certain halogenated salicylanilides and hexachlorophene [1].  

21 CFR 700.11(b) provides that regulatory proceedings may be initiated for any cosmetic preparation containing bithionol shipped after March 15, 1968 [2].
